entry.title: Build a Better Shopping Experience with OpenAI | Shopping Agent Demo

media:group.media:title: Build a Better Shopping Experience with OpenAI | Shopping Agent Demo
media:group.media:description:
See how an AI shopping agent can turn a room photo into a personalized shopping experience—from finding the right products to updating an order.
In this demo for fictional home goods retailer Vesper & Alder, a shopper uses voice and images to create a cozy reading nook. The agent recommends products, generates a preview of the room, adjusts selections to fit a $250 budget, and suggests a complementary throw blanket. After checkout, it helps switch the order from store pickup to home delivery—all through conversation.
This demo brings together two OpenAI models: GPT-Live-1 powers natural voice conversations to help shoppers find what they’re looking for. GPT-Images-2.6 creates and edits images to preview furniture in photos of shoppers’ own rooms.
Explore what you can build with OpenAI: https://openai.com/solutions/industries/retail/

media:group.media:title: Cooking with Codex: Ep. 1
media:group.media:description:
In this episode of Cooking with Codex, an OpenAI dot helps plan a ramen recipe and organize prep in ChatGPT Space, with GPT-Live guiding the cooking process.
Also covered: Codex cloud environments, which keep tasks running after a laptop is closed, and new Codex CLI features including voice input, agent management, and forking conversations into separate worktrees.
Matthew and Brian from Forward Future join to build an 8-bit ramen game using Ultrafast and play it on a ModRetro.
Plus, a showcase of community projects, from a retro space shooter to a racing game featuring hand-drawn horses.
